design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (vehicle_purchase_deals, M=2) — round 7 (seed only, S1): the two service early-payment discount credits and their ACH payments re-priced by the published service rules (5.82 / 477.96, 16.63 / 1343.64); open_balance, every scored value, baseline and sensitivity unchanged. Round 3: N1 (the delivery-fee replaced_by again restates that every home delivery fee is posted once per deal under charge_code home_delivery_fee on the delivery date), N2 (the more-than-15-days-late tier now charges late_floor_share of the miles beyond the radius, capped at late_long_cap_miles, never more than the 1-15-day tier, so the late concession never shrinks as lateness grows), T0-4 (seed check says 'deposit with payment_method check'), money rounding written RND(x + 0.000000001, 2) (exact ties round half up); no figure of this task changed. Round 2 (audit items C2a, C3, C4, C6, C7, C8, C9c/e, C10, T0-1, T0-3 closed; figures from verify.py runs on the round-2 charter).

0. DRAW (draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[5,6,5,5]. purchase_ext_fleet_delivery_fee 5, purchase_ext_fleet_unit_incentive 5, purchase_ext_fleet_late_balance_fee 6, purchase_ext_fleet_order_deposit 5 (unchanged from round 1).

1. WHY A GOOD TEST. The fleet owner asks only to bring the order deposit on her reserved F-550 up to the full order deposit and to pay it herself by ACH. The order-deposit rule waits on a record state on another deal: every delivered fleet deal of the buyer past its late balance assessment day with a balance still due must carry the late balance fee for the current billing month. Her F-350 deal (KCV-26-10587, delivered 2026-08-22, assessment day 2026-10-01, balance 31609.35) has no 2026-10 fee. That fee is fixed only after the home delivery fee posted on the F-350 has been checked against the fleet home delivery fee and any excess reversed (action form), and is not worked out until the manufacturer fleet incentive owed on the qualifying unit stands credited (state form). Both prerequisites change the balance the fee is figured on (value_input). Four exact computations of 5-6 factors over the purchase ledger, dates and the buyer's commercial service account and repair-order ledger.

2. SCOPE. Task 0 claims purchase_ext_fleet_delivery_fee, purchase_ext_fleet_unit_incentive, purchase_ext_fleet_late_balance_fee, purchase_ext_fleet_order_deposit and tools reverse_fleet_delivery_fee_7a0a59bd, credit_fleet_incentive_b735a70c, post_fleet_late_fee_7ed43dd7, pay_fleet_order_deposit_c9caca35. Task 1 holds the non-fleet extension pair; disjoint.

3. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root purchase_ext_fleet_order_deposit (on_request, owner=user).
 E1 order_deposit -> late_balance_fee: state_gate, gate purchase_transactions.billing_month, form state, sentence (negated): "A fleet order deposit is not taken on a reserved unit until every delivered Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement of the buyer that is past its late balance assessment day with a balance still due above 0.00 carries a late balance fee for the current billing month." (C3: the balance clause now matches the condition.) Opening evidence: deal A delivered 2026-08-22, balance_due 31609.35, no late_balance_fee row. Only the late-fee rule books late_balance_fee rows.
 E2 late_balance_fee -> delivery_fee: value_input on deal_balance, form ACTION (C2a), sentence (affirmative): "The fleet late balance fee is fixed only after the home delivery fee posted on the deal has been checked against the fleet home delivery fee and any excess reversed." fallback_reason: the check leaves an entry only when it finds an excess; a fee posted at or below the fleet fee gets none, so checked and unchecked deals carry the same records, and whether an excess exists is the fee computation itself. Opening: home_delivery_fee 157.50 posted 2026-08-22, no reversal; fleet fee 131.17.
 E3 late_balance_fee -> unit_incentive: value_input on deal_balance, form state, sentence (negated): "The fleet late balance fee is not worked out until the manufacturer fleet incentive owed on a qualifying unit stands credited on the deal." Record test: six 2026 fleet units delivered (five on 2026-03-10 plus A) >= 5, no manufacturer_incentive row on A.
 Topological order: delivery_fee, unit_incentive, late_balance_fee, order_deposit; E2/E3 commute (each adds one row and moves balance_due by its own amount; neither reads the other's row).
 Deletion sensitivity (verify.py): skip reversal -> late fee 171.90 (gold 171.74); skip incentive -> 188.12; skip late fee -> deposit unchanged 5066.79, the 2026-10 fee row missing (state_gate).
 user_scenario never names the F-350 charges, the incentive, the reversal or a late fee; consent comes only after the agent says something must be put through first. Tools check no prerequisite; they enforce only published argument formats.

4. FACTOR CARD (tier taken; evidence; result with that factor alone at baseline).
 delivery_fee (reversal 26.33 = posted 157.50 - fleet fee 131.17; whole baseline 0.00; free radius is the deal type's 150 miles for every factor, C6a closed):
  commercial_standing_share [param, X service, multi-source]: Net 30 active AND 0 service late fees in 12 whole months (2025-08-05 is 14 months back: near-miss) -> 0.80; baseline 1 -> 0.00.
  price_class_mile_rate [param]: vehicle_price charged 54860.00 -> 1.45/mi; baseline 1.25 -> 40.20.
  weekend_delivery [param]: Saturday 2026-08-22 -> 45.00; baseline 0 -> 56.93.
  late_delivery_miles [method]: 6 days past the window end 2026-08-16 -> max(0.5*126, 126 - 4*6) = 102 miles (more than 15 days late would be min(0.5*126, 50) = 50; no tier zeroes the miles, so no tier makes another factor inert, and the concession never shrinks as lateness grows); baseline 126 -> 2.66.
  account_tenure_share [param, X service]: account opened 2019-04-08, 90 whole months -> 0.85; baseline 1 -> 3.18.
 unit_incentive (2750.00; whole baseline 1150.00; C7/C8/C9c/C10 closed: upfit and closeout factors removed, the vehicle price is read by one factor only, the assembly sentence names no factor):
  unit_price_class [param]: vehicle_price 54860.00 -> 1650; baseline 1150 -> 2250.00.
  quarterly_program [param]: delivered in August -> 500; baseline 0 -> 2250.00.
  order_bank_lead [param]: contract 2026-07-17 to delivery 2026-08-22 = 36 days -> 300; baseline 0 -> 2450.00.
  registered_fleet_size [param, X service]: Net 30 active -> 350; baseline 0 -> 2400.00.
  registration_report_timing [method]: title filed 12 days after delivery -> 2800.00 - 25.00*2 = 2750.00 (floor half not binding); baseline summed -> 2800.00.
 late_balance_fee (171.74 on balance 28833.02; whole baseline 360.41; C4 closed: credit-hold accounts take the base fee and timing, days after the assessment day floored at 0):
  payment_standing_rate [param, X service, multi-source] -> 0.0100; baseline -> 210.78. open_credit_use [param, X service] 10724.70/25000 = 0.429 -> +0.0010; baseline -> 156.13.
  late_fee_history_basis [method] first fee -> 28833.02 * 20/30; baseline -> 257.62. paid_down_share [param] 25000.00 = 45.6% -> 0.90 (near-miss: counting the deposit transfer gives 50.1%); baseline -> 190.83.
  service_early_payer [param, X service] 2 credits -> 0.95; baseline -> 180.78. down_payment_record [param] 2500.00 = 4.56% -> 0.95; baseline -> 180.78.
 order_deposit (5066.79; whole baseline 3634.00; C6b closed: the credit-hold tier keeps the rate (rate x price + the whole open balance), so no tier makes the rate factors inert):
  commercial_standing_rate [param, X service] 0.05; baseline -> 8670.03. service_late_history [param, X service] +0.025; baseline -> 3265.18. extended_hold_rate [param] 7 days beyond standard -> +0.02; baseline -> 3625.50.
  check_funds_rate [param] one check deposit -> +0.01; baseline -> 4346.15. account_exposure_base [method] active Net 30 with open_balance 10724.70 -> 0.105 * 72064.70; baseline 0.105 * 61340.00 -> 3940.70.

5. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Reversal (purchase_charge_reversed): doc-fee, exchange and spot-delivery policies have no gate on this event (policy_scope). Incentive (purchase_payment_posted): one_incentive_per_deal holds (no manufacturer_incentive row on A); certified_funds_period holds (no purchase_payment_returned for the buyer). Late fee (purchase_charge_posted): past_assessment_day — anchor delivery_date 2026-08-22 + 40 calendar days (delivery date day 0) = 2026-10-01, exclusive, assessable from 2026-10-02; 2026-10-21 holds (2026-10-01 would fail); one_late_fee_per_month and one_doc_fee_per_deal hold. Deposit: deal_open_for_deposit holds; total 2500.00 + 5066.79 = 7566.79 <= 25000; ach allowed.

6. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Reversal points at A's home_delivery_fee charge. Incentive, late fee: deal A only; the five closed units already carry their incentives (2150.00 x2, 1650.00 x3, the same rule on their March world: class + 150 order-bank bonus (29 days) + 350 fleet-size, no program cash in March, title 8 days after delivery). Deposit: deal B only. One service account SA-152804.

7. SEED (T0-1 closed). Five closed 2026 fleet units with complete ledgers; deal A (deposit, contract charges, standard-schedule home delivery fee 157.50, deposit applied, ACH 25000.00 on 2026-09-18); deal B reservation 2500.00 by check, hold extended once; service account Net 30 opened 2019-04-08 with five repair orders: RO 160118 paid 2025-08-20 with its 25.00 late fee (2025-08-05), RO 160342 and RO 160497 paid by ACH within 7 days with early-payment discount credits priced by the published service rules as of each payment date (round 7, S1: (2% tier rate + 0.5% Net 30 tenure addition, 83 and 86 whole months) x discountable labor+parts x 0.5 standing share for the 2025-08-05 late fee: 465.40 -> 5.82 on 2026-03-11 and 1330.05 -> 16.63 on 2026-06-16, no prompt-payer addition (fewer than 8 payments in 12 months), units are 2022 F-250s not bought on a closed group fleet deal, no comeback credits; credits booked on labor line A; ACH payments 477.96 and 1343.64 = invoice less discount), RO 160615 (8115.95, 2026-09-29) and RO 160688 (2608.75, 2026-10-12) open and not yet due. open_balance 10724.70 = 8115.95 + 2608.75, equal to the ledger total charges 13546.84 - credits 22.45 - payments 2799.69 (round 1 carried 11677.79, which double-counted the paid RO 160118). No automatic clause fires.

8. PERSONA. Volunteers only the goal; identity, deal number and pay method on request; passive consent; runs the user tool on hand-over; declines extras; ends on the receipt.

9. STANDARD SOLUTION / VERIFICATION. Reads: customer (phone), verify (phone + EIN last four), deals, transactions, service account, RO lines, vehicles, store. Writes: reversal 26.33 -> incentive 2750.00 -> late fee 2026-10 171.74 -> user ACH deposit 5066.79. verify.py replays gold writes through the real tools to each handling-time world and evaluates with check_compute's environment; equal to computations.expected and the gold arguments.

10. DRAFT FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. The deposit rule's sentence points at the delivered F-350 (past 2026-10-01, balance due, no October fee); the late-fee rule sends the reader to check the posted 157.50 against the fleet schedule (131.17) and to the missing incentive (six 2026 units); each computation follows from its baseline paragraph plus the factor rules the records trigger; same four writes, same values.
user_scenario: You are Carla Dunmore, owner of Dunmore Grounds & Snow LLC, a landscaping and snow-removal outfit out of Springfield, Ohio. You are calling the Kessler support desk on a busy Wednesday morning between crew dispatches; you are friendly but clipped, and you like to get to the point. Earlier this month your company reserved a new 2026 Ford F-550 chassis cab at the Kessler Commercial Vehicle Center for a dump body build. You want to bring the deposit on that F-550 up to the full order deposit today so the unit is locked in, and you will push the payment yourself by ACH from the company's operating account once the desk tells you the figure. You do not know what the figure is; that is what you are calling for. Only when the agent asks, you give the company name exactly as Dunmore Grounds & Snow LLC, the phone number on the account, 9375551184, and the last four of the company EIN, 1862; if a third detail is wanted, the billing ZIP is 45505. If the agent asks which reservation, you read the deal number off the reservation paperwork, KCV-26-10731, and describe it as the white F-550 chassis cab. If the agent asks how you want to pay, it is ACH from the operating account, never a card. You bring up nothing about any other truck. If the agent asks about the F-350 your crew took delivery of in August, you say it is in service plowing-ready and that its remaining balance is going out with your regular payables run, not today. If the agent explains that something on another deal has to be put through first, or that charges, credits or a late fee are being posted on the F-350, you say that is fine, go ahead and put through whatever your records call for, you just want the new truck's deposit taken care of today; you do not question or negotiate any of those figures. Once the agent tells you the deposit amount and hands you the payment to make, you make the ACH deposit for exactly that amount on the F-550 reservation, then read the receipt back. If the agent offers anything else, such as paying down the F-350 now, you politely decline. When you have the deposit receipt in hand, you thank the agent and end the call.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: Calendar days are added to the txn_date of the customer's latest purchase_payment_returned row; the period covers the boundary day, so such payments are accepted from the next calendar day.

boundary_check.just_before: Had the buyer a purchase_payment_returned row dated 2026-08-23, 2026-10-21 would be 59 days after it, inside the 60-day certified-funds period for check/ACH/card money; the incentive is not such money and the buyer has no returned payment at all, so the gate holds.

temporal_feasibility.condition: A late balance fee is assessed only when the handling date is later than the delivery date plus late_balance_assess_after_days calendar days.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: Calendar days are added to the delivery date (the delivery date is day 0); the fee can be assessed from the calendar day after that sum, never on the boundary day itself.

boundary_check.at_boundary: From 2026-10-02 the fee is assessable; on 2026-10-21 it is.

edges.condition: every delivered Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement of the buyer whose handling date is later than its delivery date plus late_balance_assess_after_days calendar days and whose balance_due is above 0.00 has a purchase_charge_posted row with charge_code late_balance_fee and billing_month equal to the handling month.
edges.policy_source: A fleet order deposit is not taken on a reserved unit until every delivered Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement of the buyer that is past its late balance assessment day with a balance still due above 0.00 carries a late balance fee for the current billing month.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Deal A is a delivered fleet deal past its assessment day (2026-10-01) with a balance above 0.00, and none of its purchase_transactions rows carries charge_code late_balance_fee with billing_month 2026-10.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 13 books the 2026-10 late_balance_fee row (171.74) on deal A; the condition then holds for every past-due delivered fleet deal of the buyer with a balance due.

edges.condition: the home delivery fee charged on the deal (purchase_charge_posted rows with charge_code home_delivery_fee less purchase_charge_reversed rows with that charge code) is not above the fleet home delivery fee, which is the state the check-and-reverse action leaves.
edges.policy_source: The fleet late balance fee is fixed only after the home delivery fee posted on the deal has been checked against the fleet home delivery fee and any excess reversed.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The home delivery fee charged on deal A is 157.50 with no reversal, above the fleet home delivery fee of 131.17; the check-and-reverse has not been done.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 9 books a 26.33 home_delivery_fee reversal pointing at that charge; net charged becomes 131.17 and balance_due falls by 26.33.

edges.fallback_reason: The check leaves a record only when it finds an excess: a home delivery fee posted at or below the fleet home delivery fee is left as posted and gets no entry, so a deal whose fee was checked and a deal whose fee was never checked carry the same records; whether an excess exists is the fleet home delivery fee computation itself, not a state any record shows. The dependency can therefore only be stated as the action.

edges.condition: purchase_transactions holds a purchase_payment_posted row with payment_method manufacturer_incentive for the deal whenever the deal is a qualifying fleet deal.
edges.policy_source: The fleet late balance fee is not worked out until the manufacturer fleet incentive owed on a qualifying unit stands credited on the deal.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Deal A is the buyer's sixth fleet unit delivered in 2026 (threshold 5) and no manufacturer_incentive credit stands on it.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 11 books the 2750.00 manufacturer_incentive credit on deal A; balance_due falls by 2750.00.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The reversal and the incentive are parallel prerequisites of the late fee. Each adds one purchase_transactions row to deal A and moves balance_due by its own amount; the reversal's compute reads posted home_delivery_fee rows, the vehicle_price charge, service records and dates, the incentive's compute reads the vehicle_price charge, dates and the service account, so neither reads the other's row. Either order gives balance 28833.02 before the late fee, the same 171.74 fee and the same terminal rows (ids are argument-derived). The late fee precedes the deposit (E1); both prerequisites precede the late fee (E2, E3).

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping step 13 leaves deal A without the 2026-10 late_balance_fee row (terminal purchase_transactions differs; deal A balance_due 28833.02 instead of 29004.76); the deposit amount itself stays 5066.79 (state_gate).
Skipping the reversal leaves balance 28859.35 at the late fee; fee becomes 171.90 instead of 171.74.
Skipping the incentive leaves balance 31583.02 at the late fee; fee becomes 188.12 instead of 171.74.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario raises only the order deposit on the reserved F-550. It never mentions a home delivery fee, a reversal, a manufacturer incentive or a late fee; the F-350 appears only as a passive answer if the agent asks, and consent to work on it is a reaction after the agent says something must be put through first.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: pay_fleet_order_deposit_c9caca35, post_fleet_late_fee_7ed43dd7, credit_fleet_incentive_b735a70c and reverse_fleet_delivery_fee_7a0a59bd each read the deal row only to carry customer_id and the running balance, then create one purchase_transactions row and update balance_due or deposit_held_balance; none reads another deal, checks a status, a fee or a credit, or returns an error.
